title: get api health returns ok status and release id when healthy
description: Verify that GET /api/health returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing {status: ok, release: <id>} when the application and database are responding properly.

title: get api health returns error status when unhealthy
description: Verify that GET /api/health returns HTTP 503 with a JSON body containing {status: error} when the application or database is not responding.

title: get sanctum csrf cookie sets xsrf token and session cookies
description: Verify that GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie returns HTTP 204 and sets the XSRF-TOKEN and session cookies required for CSRF-protected authentication.

title: post api auth login succeeds with valid credentials and xsrf token
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password along with a valid X-XSRF-TOKEN header returns HTTP 200 with user roles and permissions.

title: post api auth login fails with invalid credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials returns HTTP 422 validation error.

title: post api auth login fails without csrf cookie or xsrf token
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login without first obtaining CSRF cookie or without a valid X-XSRF-TOKEN header results in authentication failure or validation error.

title: get api auth me returns authenticated user with valid session
description: Verify that GET /api/auth/me with a valid authenticated session returns HTTP 200 with the authenticated user information.

title: get api auth me returns 401 without authenticated session
description: Verify that GET /api/auth/me without an authenticated session returns HTTP 401 unauthenticated error.

title: get api public settings returns public church settings excluding notification recipients
description: Verify that GET /api/public/settings returns HTTP 200 with public church settings including schedule, address, WhatsApp, and YouTube, and that the response does not contain the notification_recipients field.
